result.title: Learning to Edit IFC Building Models: Verifiable Checkers as the Training Signal for Dependency-Aware Editing Agents
result.summary: Editing a building information model in the Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) schema requires propagating changes to dependent elements while preserving unrelated entities. Existing language-model agents for IFC editing use prompted models without learning from edit outcomes. Target-file comparisons do not specify which alternative edits are allowed or which unrelated entities must remain unchanged. We present IfcGym, a CodeAct environment in which a language model edits IFC through executable code and four checkers verify validity relative to the input model, intent, dependency and preservation against a task specification. Their conjunction is strict success. IfcEdit distils verified teacher episodes into a Qwen3.5-9B student through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with strict success as the reward. On IfcEditBench, 1,990 editing tasks on 13 held-out real projects, the final student reaches 86.78% strict success, from 79.15% after SFT. The paired confidence interval for the difference from its teacher includes zero; the same recipe on a 27B model reaches 91.76% and exceeds the teacher. On the public benchmarks BIM-Edit and BIBIMBAP the final student scores 55.19 and 54.50. On IfcEditBench, the students outperform all prompted models except the teacher under matched tool access; both evaluated frameworks also score lower. Rewarding all four checkers yields 4.83 points more strict success than rewarding intent and validity alone.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 IfcGym 代码编辑环境，用有效性、意图、依赖传播与无关实体保持四个 checker 的联合判定作为严格成功信号，将教师轨迹经 SFT 蒸馏到 Qwen3.5-9B 后再用 GRPO 优化，并在自建与公开 IFC 编辑基准上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「依赖需传播、无关需保持」的多检查器联合奖励与严格成功判据，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要信息保留、无关信息不被改写以及监督与贡献分配提供可核查的奖励设计线索；但论文本身不涉及视觉 latent 推理。
